title_zh: 平衡模组 · 五节点图学习
scope_en: An exploratory task-level graph from a frozen visual interface without learned calibration. Beam–ball feedback remains; the load-to-ball link can reflect an ancestor effect. Some relations are missing or unresolved. This is not certified full-DAG recovery or an ACC benchmark.
scope_zh: 这是未加入学习型校准的冻结视觉接口得到的任务层候选图。横梁与球仍有反馈；载荷到球的关系可能是祖先效应。部分关系漏检或未定向，不等于认证的完整 DAG 恢复或 ACC 基准结果。
timing: Phase-based speed changes; labels describe recorded replay speed. Reading pauses remain.
